description: Per-finding fusion weights of fuse_findings (p_final = logistic(intercept + w . x)). Fitted 2026-11-19 by logistic regression (w_static, w_rag, w_corroborated >= 0; L2 = 1) on the local findings of the 1,110 real functions of the v12 val+test split (label = the function's label; kaggle_ds2 synthetic excluded). tau_agent maximises F2 (recall-first) of 'reaches the Fixer'. 5-fold x 3 CV: recall 0.664 -> 0.708, FPR 0.130 -> 0.228. Scripts and results: data/results/heuristics_tuning/.
